text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
We've beaten a bunch of monsters now, huh?!
Looks like there's plenty left, but they're no match for us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
結構な数の魔物を倒したッスね！
まだまだいるみたいッスが、
このままいけば余裕ッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep it up until peace is restored!
I know you'll stick with me, right?
Your power is a massive help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガンガン倒して、
平和を取り戻すッスよ！
あなたも
ついてきてくれるッスよね？
その力、
頼りになるッス！
